hooks.description: [xdf] CloudBase template prewarm + BaaS brief during credential wait

_comment: Replace __XDF_PACK_ROOT__ with the absolute path to plugin/xdf-workbuddy-expert-pack (or run scripts/render-settings.sh). Merge ONLY the SessionStart entry into ~/.workbuddy/settings.json — stack with existing teamai hooks; do not replace the whole hooks object. Do NOT enable allowUntrustedFrontmatterHooks for this path. Opt out: CLOUDBASE_WORKBUDDY_PREWARM=0. Skip preview start: CLOUDBASE_WORKBUDDY_PREVIEW=0. Template: CLOUDBASE_WORKBUDDY_TEMPLATE=react|vue. Keep sibling plugin/cloudbase-sites (or set CLOUDBASE_SITES_BIN) for ports 17173..17272.
